description:
Can you solve this Star Battle puzzle before the computer does? 🧠⭐

Rules: place exactly one star in every row, every column and every colored region — and no two stars may touch, not even diagonally. (Same puzzle as LinkedIn Queens.)

The computer solves it with a depth-first search: it places stars row by row, and whenever a row, column or region runs out of room it backtracks and tries the next option.

Three new puzzles every day — follow so you never miss one!

Play it yourself: https://clrke.github.io/vue-star-battle/

#shorts #starbattle #queens #puzzle #logicpuzzle #algorithm #satisfying
